Size only mapped from variant options labelled *Size*; custom fields like "Wheel Size"/"Lock Size" left unmapped (compatibility spec, not apparel size)
Options not named Size/Color (e.g. Gender, Cartridge Quantity) appended to title
price--rrp (MSRP) ignored; sale detected only via non-sale-price
